home.emptyText: Murmur transcribes as you talk and tells who says what. Everything stays on your phone.
home.consent: Recording requires the consent of everyone taking part.

notes.heading: Heading
notes.noCamera: Murmur needs the camera to take photos. You can allow it in the iPhone's Settings.

meeting.pending: When the phone finds your computer, it will add the title, the summary and the Whisper pass. For now this is the quick transcript.
meeting.deleteConfirm: The meeting and its audio will be deleted from this phone.
meeting.pendingUnpaired: This is the phone's quick transcript. Connect your computer in Settings and it'll go there on its own: it listens to it again with Whisper and writes the summary.
meeting.sent: It's on the computer now, which will listen to it again with Whisper. When it's done, the revised version will arrive here.
meeting.revised: Revised on the computer: Whisper, speakers and summary.

settings.title: Settings
settings.privacy: Meetings stay on your phone and on the computer you connect. They never go through any server.
settings.micHint: Automatic uses a wired or USB microphone if there is one, otherwise the iPhone's. Bluetooth headphones only if you pick them: they only hear whoever is wearing them, not the room.
settings.computerHint: Meetings go to it on their own when both are on the same network: the computer listens to them again with Whisper and writes the summary.
settings.keepAudio: Keep the audio on the phone
settings.keepAudioHint: When off, the audio is deleted from the phone once the computer has all of it, to save space. The computer needs it to redo the meeting.
settings.analyticsHint: Which features are used, how long meetings last and which version and system you have, with no identifier. Never titles, text, names, notes or audio. They help us decide what to improve.

mic.denied: Murmur needs the microphone to record. Turn it on in Settings › Murmur.

infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Murmur listens to the microphone to transcribe the meeting. Everything stays on your phone.
infoPlist.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Murmur looks for your computer on the local network to pass it your meetings, encrypted.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Murmur uses the camera only to read your computer's QR code.

sync.autoHint: When the phone and the computer are on the same network and Murmur is open on both.
sync.unpairConfirm: Meetings already there stay there. To connect it again you'll need the QR code.
sync.unreachable: Can't find it on the network. Check it's on the same Wi-Fi and Murmur is open.
sync.notPaired: This computer isn't connected any more. Connect it again with the QR code.

pair.title: Connect your computer
pair.heading: Scan the code on your computer
pair.step2: Go to Settings › Phone › Connect a Phone.
pair.after: Then every meeting you record on the phone goes to the computer, encrypted, when both are on the same network. The computer listens to it again and sends you back the summary.
pair.expired: The code isn't on the computer's screen any more. Open Connect a Phone again.
pair.unreachable: Can't find the computer. Check both are on the same Wi-Fi.
pair.noCamera: Murmur needs the camera to read the code. You can allow it in the iPhone's Settings.

cover.noTasks: No tasks were requested in this meeting.

search.title: Search
search.hint: Searches titles, what was said and the notes.

tags.title: Tags
tags.hint: To sort meetings by client or project. They're the same as on the computer.

voice.title: Your Voice
voice.sentence: Good morning. I'm the one who uses this phone, and this is my voice when I speak in a meeting.
voice.ready: Press the button and read the sentence aloud.
voice.savedText: Murmur knows you as “You” in every meeting you record with this phone, also when there are more of you in the room.
voice.none: Read a sentence and Murmur will know you as “You”, also when there are more of you in the room.
voice.bio: This is biometric data: a print of how your voice sounds, not a recording. It stays only on this phone and never goes to the computer.
voice.deleteMessage: Murmur will stop recognising you automatically. You can record it again whenever you like.

recMenu.discardMessage: It will stop and be deleted from the phone, with its audio and notes. This can't be undone.

onboarding.welcomeTagline: Transcribe your meetings live, with Catalan at the centre.
onboarding.welcomePrivate: Private, because it all happens on the phone. Nothing leaves it unless you want it to.
onboarding.f1Title: See the text as you speak
onboarding.f1Text: Murmur transcribes the meeting as it happens, in Catalan and Spanish, on the phone.
onboarding.f2Title: Who speaks and what you note
onboarding.f2Text: It tells the voices apart, and the notes, photos and moments you mark keep their exact minute.
onboarding.f3Text: Leave it on the table: the meeting goes on, and from the lock screen you mark, pause or stop.
onboarding.f4Text: With Murmur on your computer and on the same network, every meeting goes there on its own. The computer listens to it again, writes the summary and sends it back to the phone.
onboarding.setupTitle: You can change it for each meeting
onboarding.consent: Recording a meeting needs the consent of everyone taking part.
onboarding.micText: To listen to the meeting and transcribe it. The audio stays on the phone: nothing goes to any server.
onboarding.micDenied: Without the microphone it can't record. You can allow it in the iPhone's Settings.
onboarding.voiceText: A print of your voice, not a recording: biometric data. It stays on this phone and you can delete it in Settings.
onboarding.computerTitle: Do you have Murmur on your computer?
onboarding.computerText: Connect them with the QR code in Settings › Phone, and meetings will go there on their own when both are on the same network.
onboarding.computerDownload: Don't have it yet? murmur.quicodomingo.com, for macOS, Windows and Linux.
onboarding.demoLine1: So if you agree, we close the budget on Thursday

android.channelText: The pinned notification while Murmur records a meeting, with Mark, Pause and Stop.
